Probe2 remesure reproduces fail_open_count=1 and fail_open_labels=['ssot_drift_gate.py default'] with detector_control_excluded_count=5; only environmental drift is unitgate no-args exit 1->0 depending on dirty-tree findings, still measured=True fail_open=False. (2) unitgate.py no-args prints units=/artifacts= and is NOT fail-open (classifier now recognizes those tokens; floors still fail-closed when counts collapse). (3) All five --self-test cases are detector_control=True and excluded from the tally. (4) validate empty known-bad exits 1; suitefloor no-args exits 1. Attempt to inflate the count by reclassifying self-tests or unitgate fails. Attempt to deflate by denying ssot fail-open fails against its own stdout and source. Residual_unknowns (non-.py workflow shell gates not all executed empty) remains NOT-CHECKED and does not move the measured headline of 1 among the 13 probe2 cases.
